title: First Responder Breakfast Bake
description: A hearty breakfast casserole with eggs, sausage, bacon, potatoes, cheese, and crescent rolls.
steps: Add six scrambled eggs to a mixing bowl and whisk.
Add cooked sausage, crumbled bacon, and Potatoes O'Brien to the eggs and mix until well combined.
Drop a tube of crescent rolls into a greased baking dish, fitting it to cover the bottom.
Sprinkle a handful of shredded sharp cheddar cheese over the crescent rolls.
Spread the egg and meat mixture evenly over the cheese.
Sprinkle some OG steak seasoning on top of the mixture.
Add another handful of shredded sharp cheddar cheese over the mixture.
Cover with a second sheet of crescent rolls.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10 to 15 minutes, until golden and crispy.
Remove from oven, cut into pieces, and serve.

healthy: Eggs, sausage and bacon give lots of protein.
Potatoes O'Brien add some potato, pepper and onion.
not_healthy: Sausage, bacon and cheddar are processed or fatty and high in saturated fat.
Very high in sodium from processed meats and steak seasoning.
Crescent rolls are refined flour with added fat.
